reason: EUR 6,500 locked in for three months with no meetings guaranteed is a lot for a firm like mine. I've run Lemlist and a freelancer myself, and I think I can get most of this done in-house for a fraction of that.
objection: Do they actually understand logistics and 3PL buyers, or is it the same templates with a different company name on top? Our deals come from trust and trade fairs, and a cold email from a domain I don't own won't get a shipper to move their freight.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a 3PL or logistics client in the region, with real meetings booked, plus a one-month paid pilot so I'm not tied in for three months.
